ops.summary: Watch the site, keep a record of what happens on it, automate its chores and keep it up to date: audit log, statistics, import, security, updates, health, observability, tools and scheduled tasks.

quickstart.step1: Open “Health” to check that the database, storage and queues are answering.
quickstart.step2: Read the “Audit log” to see who changed what, and “Statistics” for traffic.
quickstart.step3: In “Scheduled tasks”, check that scheduled publications and the trash purge are running.
quickstart.step4: Before updating the site, open “Updates”: a restore point is created first.
